testcase_name: Punch in successfully with valid date, time and timezone
test_objective: Verify an employee can punch in successfully with all valid required fields.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to Time > Attendance > Punch In/Out
3. Confirm current date, time, timezoneOffset and timezoneName are populated
expected_results: Attendance record is created with state 'PUNCHED IN' and punch-in date/time/timezone are saved correctly.

testcase_name: Punch in fails when date field is missing
test_objective: Verify punch in request is rejected when the required 'date' field is not provided.
test_steps: 2. Send Punch In request without 'date' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error indicating 'date' is required; no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in fails when time field is missing
test_objective: Verify punch in request is rejected when the required 'time' field is not provided.
test_steps: 2. Send Punch In request without 'time' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error indicating 'time' is required; no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in fails when timezoneOffset is missing
test_objective: Verify punch in request is rejected when the required 'timezoneOffset' field is not provided.
test_steps: 2. Send Punch In request without 'timezoneOffset' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error for missing timezoneOffset; no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in fails when timezoneName is missing
test_objective: Verify punch in request is rejected when the required 'timezoneName' field is not provided.
test_steps: 2. Send Punch In request without 'timezoneName' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error for missing timezoneName; no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in fails with invalid time format
test_objective: Verify punch in rejects a time value that does not match the required 'H:i' format.
test_steps: 2. Send Punch In request with time='25:99' (invalid format)
expected_results: API returns a TIME format validation error and no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in note accepted up to 250 characters
test_objective: Verify the punch-in note field is accepted when it is at the maximum allowed length of 250 characters.
test_steps: 2. Enter a punch-in note of exactly 250 characters
expected_results: Punch in succeeds and the 250-character note is saved without truncation.

testcase_name: Punch in fails when note exceeds 250 characters
test_objective: Verify punch in is rejected when the note field exceeds the 250 character maximum length.
test_steps: 2. Enter a punch-in note of 251 characters
expected_results: API returns a LENGTH validation error for punchInNote/note and no attendance record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in blocked when an overlapping punched-in record already exists
test_objective: Verify punch in is rejected with 'Punch-In Overlap Found' when the employee already has an overlapping open attendance record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who already has an active punched-in record
2. Attempt to Punch In again with a date/time that overlaps the existing open record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Punch-In Overlap Found'; no new record is created.

testcase_name: Punch in rejected when system time is altered beyond tolerance and 'Allow employees to change time' is disabled
test_objective: Verify punch in fails with 'Provided Date And Time Invalid' when the configuration disallows changing current time and the supplied date/time differs from the actual server time by more than 180 seconds.
test_steps: 1. As Admin, disable 'Allow Employees to Change Punch In/Out Time' in Attendance Configuration
3. Submit Punch In with a date/time more than 3 minutes different from the real current time
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Provided Date And Time Invalid'; punch in is rejected.

testcase_name: Punch in succeeds when time is within +/-180 second tolerance and time-change is disabled
test_objective: Verify punch in succeeds when 'Allow employees to change time' is disabled but the supplied date/time is within the 180-second margin of the actual current time.
test_steps: 1. As Admin, disable 'Allow Employees to Change Punch In/Out Time'
3. Submit Punch In using the real current date/time (within 3 minutes)
expected_results: Punch in succeeds and attendance record is created with state 'PUNCHED IN'.

testcase_name: Punch in succeeds without an optional note
test_objective: Verify punch in succeeds when the optional 'note' field is left blank.
test_steps: 2. Leave the punch-in note field empty
expected_results: Punch in succeeds and the attendance record is saved with a null/empty note.

testcase_name: Punch out successfully after an active punch in
test_objective: Verify an employee who is currently punched in can punch out successfully.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is currently punched in
2. Navigate to Time > Attendance > Punch In/Out
3. Click Punch Out with valid date/time/timezone
expected_results: The open attendance record is updated to state 'PUNCHED OUT' with punch-out date/time/timezone saved.

testcase_name: Punch out fails when employee has no active punch-in record
test_objective: Verify punch out is rejected with 'Cannot Proceed Punch Out Employee Already Punched Out' when there is no open punch-in record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is already punched out (no open record)
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Cannot Proceed Punch Out Employee Already Punched Out'.

testcase_name: Punch out fails when date field is missing
test_objective: Verify punch out request is rejected when the required 'date' field is not provided.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Send Punch Out request without 'date' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error indicating 'date' is required; record remains in PUNCHED IN state.

testcase_name: Punch out fails when time field is missing
test_objective: Verify punch out request is rejected when the required 'time' field is not provided.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Send Punch Out request without 'time' parameter
expected_results: API returns a validation error indicating 'time' is required; record remains in PUNCHED IN state.

testcase_name: Punch out fails with invalid timezoneOffset value
test_objective: Verify punch out is rejected when timezoneOffset does not match the expected TIMEZONE_OFFSET format.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Send Punch Out request with timezoneOffset='ABC'
expected_results: API returns a TIMEZONE_OFFSET validation error; punch out is rejected.

testcase_name: Punch out blocked when new punch-out time overlaps another attendance record
test_objective: Verify punch out is rejected with 'Punch-Out Overlap Found' when the resulting punched interval overlaps an existing attendance record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Enter a punch-out date/time that overlaps another existing attendance record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Punch-Out Overlap Found'; record is not updated.

testcase_name: Punch out succeeds with an optional note within limit
test_objective: Verify punch out succeeds when an optional note of valid length is provided.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Enter a punch-out note of 50 characters
expected_results: Punch out succeeds and the note is saved with the attendance record.

testcase_name: Punch out rejected when system time is altered beyond tolerance and time-change is disabled
test_objective: Verify punch out fails with 'Provided Date And Time Invalid' when 'Allow employees to change time' is disabled and supplied time differs from actual time by more than 180 seconds.
test_steps: 1. As Admin, disable 'Allow Employees to Change Punch In/Out Time'
2. Login as ESS user who is punched in
3. Submit Punch Out with a date/time more than 3 minutes off from real current time
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Provided Date And Time Invalid'; punch out is rejected.

testcase_name: Edit punch-in time of an active (currently punched-in) record
test_objective: Verify a user with edit permission can successfully update the punch-in date/time of a record that is still in PUNCHED IN state.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with an active punched-in record
2. Navigate to the attendance record and edit the punch-in time
expected_results: Record is updated with the new punch-in date/time/note; no overlap detected.

testcase_name: Edit both punch-in and punch-out time of a completed record
test_objective: Verify a user can update both punch-in and punch-out date/time of a fully punched-out attendance record.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission on a completed attendance record
2. Edit punch-in date/time and punch-out date/time
expected_results: Record is updated successfully with both new punch-in and punch-out timestamps.

testcase_name: Edit fails when only timezoneOffset is supplied without timezoneName
test_objective: Verify editing a record fails with 'Valid Timezone Offset and Timezone Name Must Be Provided' when only one of the timezone fields is supplied.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission
2. Submit edit request with punchInOffset set but punchInTimezoneName omitted
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Valid Timezone Offset and Timezone Name Must Be Provided'.

testcase_name: Edit completed record fails when punchOutTime is missing while punchOutDate is provided
test_objective: Verify editing a PUNCHED OUT record fails with 'Punch Out Date And Time Should Not Be Null' when punchOutDate is given but punchOutTime is null.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission on a completed record
2. Submit edit request with punchOutDate set and punchOutTime omitted
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Punch Out Date And Time Should Not Be Null'.

testcase_name: Edit blocked when new punch-in time overlaps another record
test_objective: Verify editing the punch-in time is rejected with 'Punch-In Overlap Found' if the new time overlaps an existing attendance record for the same employee.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission
2. Edit punch-in time to a value overlapping another existing record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Punch-In Overlap Found'; record is not updated.

testcase_name: Edit blocked when new punch-out time overlaps another record
test_objective: Verify editing punch-out time of a completed record is rejected with 'Punch-Out Overlap Found' when the new interval overlaps another attendance record.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission on a completed record
2. Edit punch-out time to a value overlapping another existing record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'Punch-Out Overlap Found'; record is not updated.

testcase_name: Edit denied for a record the user is not authorized to modify
test_objective: Verify a user without the appropriate edit-punch-time workflow permission for the record's owner receives a 403 Forbidden.
test_steps: 1. Login as an ESS user with no supervisory relationship to the record owner
2. Attempt PUT /attendance/records/{id} for another employee's record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; record is not modified.

testcase_name: Edit fails for a non-existent attendance record ID
test_objective: Verify editing an attendance record with an ID that does not exist returns a 404 Record Not Found error.
test_steps: 2. Send PUT /attendance/records/{id} using an ID that does not exist in the system
expected_results: API returns HTTP 404 Record Not Found.

testcase_name: Delete attendance record via /attendance/records/{id} is not implemented
test_objective: Verify calling DELETE on the single-record attendance endpoint returns a Not Implemented response, confirming deletion must go through the employee-scoped delete endpoint.
expected_results: API returns a Not Implemented (405/501) response; no record is deleted.

testcase_name: Edit fails with invalid punchInDate format
test_objective: Verify editing a record is rejected when punchInDate does not conform to the expected API date format.
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission
2. Submit edit request with punchInDate='13/40/2026' (invalid format)
expected_results: API returns an API_DATE validation error; record is not updated.

testcase_name: Edit record ID parameter must be a positive integer
test_objective: Verify editing an attendance record fails validation when the {id} path parameter is not a positive integer (e.g. 0 or negative).
test_steps: 1. Login as user with edit permission
expected_results: API returns a POSITIVE rule validation error; request is rejected before any DB lookup.

testcase_name: Delete a single own attendance record successfully
test_objective: Verify an employee with delete permission can delete one of their own attendance records.
test_steps: 3. Select one record and click Delete
expected_results: The selected record is removed and returned in the response's list of deleted IDs.

testcase_name: Delete multiple own attendance records in a single request
test_objective: Verify an employee can delete several of their own attendance records in one DELETE request using an array of IDs.
expected_results: All selected records are deleted successfully and returned in the response.

testcase_name: Delete fails when ids array is empty
test_objective: Verify deletion is rejected with 'No IDs Found' when an empty ids array is submitted.
test_steps: 2. Send DELETE request to /attendance/employees/{empNumber}/records with ids=[]
expected_results: API returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with message 'No IDs Found'; nothing is deleted.

testcase_name: Delete fails when attempting to delete a record not owned by the requesting employee
test_objective: Verify deletion is denied with 403 Forbidden when one or more supplied record IDs do not belong to the target employee.
test_steps: 2. Send DELETE request including an attendance record ID that belongs to employee B
expected_results: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; no records are deleted.

testcase_name: Delete own record denied when 'Employee can edit/delete own attendance' is disabled
test_objective: Verify an ESS user cannot delete their own attendance record when the corresponding attendance configuration is turned off.
test_steps: 1. As Admin, disable 'Employee can edit/delete own attendance records' in Attendance Configuration
3. Attempt to delete an own attendance record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; the record remains in the system.

testcase_name: Delete fails when ids parameter is not an array
test_objective: Verify the delete request is rejected by validation when the 'ids' parameter is not of array type.
test_steps: 2. Send DELETE request with ids='5' (string instead of array)
expected_results: API returns an ARRAY_TYPE validation error; request is rejected.

testcase_name: List own attendance records defaults to today's date when no filters supplied
test_objective: Verify that when no date, fromDate or toDate is supplied, the record list defaults to showing only today's attendance records.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to My Attendance Records without applying any filter
expected_results: Only attendance records for the current date are displayed along with total count and total worked-hours summary.

testcase_name: List own attendance records filtered by a specific date
test_objective: Verify filtering attendance records by the 'date' query parameter returns only records for that date.
test_steps: 2. Apply date filter for a specific past date
expected_results: Only records matching the specified date are returned.

testcase_name: List own attendance records using a fromDate/toDate range
test_objective: Verify filtering by fromDate and toDate returns all attendance records within that inclusive date range.
test_steps: 2. Set fromDate and toDate spanning a week
expected_results: All attendance records between fromDate 00:00:00 and toDate 23:59:59 are returned.

testcase_name: List fails when fromDate is later than toDate
test_objective: Verify the API rejects the request with an invalid parameter error when fromDate is chronologically after toDate.
expected_results: API returns an invalid parameter error referencing fromDate and toDate; no results are returned.

testcase_name: List own attendance records with pagination
test_objective: Verify limit and offset query parameters correctly paginate the attendance record list.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with more than 10 attendance records
2. Request the list with limit=5 and offset=5
expected_results: Exactly 5 records starting from the 6th record are returned, with correct 'total' meta value.

testcase_name: List own attendance records sorted by punch-in time
test_objective: Verify the sortField and sortOrder parameters correctly order the returned attendance records.
test_steps: 2. Request the list with sortField=punchInUserTime and sortOrder=DESC
expected_results: Records are returned in descending order of punch-in time.

testcase_name: Total worked-hours summary is calculated correctly for the filtered period
test_objective: Verify the 'sum' meta object (hours, minutes, label) accurately reflects the total working time of the returned records.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with multiple completed attendance records for the day
2. Request the attendance record list for that day
expected_results: The 'sum' object in meta reflects the correct total hours and minutes worked, matching the sum of individual record durations.

testcase_name: Admin adds a punch-in record on behalf of a subordinate employee
test_objective: Verify an Admin user can create (proxy punch in) an attendance record for any employee via /attendance/employees/{empNumber}/records.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to Employee Attendance and select an employee
expected_results: A new attendance record is created for the selected employee with state 'PUNCHED IN'.

testcase_name: Supervisor adds a punch-in record for a direct subordinate
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor with proxy punch-in permission can add an attendance record for their direct report.
expected_results: Attendance record is created for the subordinate employee.

testcase_name: Supervisor is blocked from adding a punch-in record for an employee outside their reporting hierarchy
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor cannot create an attendance record for an employee who is not their subordinate.
test_steps: 2. Attempt to POST an attendance record using the empNumber of a non-subordinate employee
expected_results: API returns a validation/forbidden error (IN_ACCESSIBLE_EMP_NUMBERS); no record is created.

testcase_name: Supervisor punches out (proxy) a subordinate who is currently punched in
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor can complete (punch out) an open attendance record for a subordinate employee.
test_steps: 2. Select a subordinate with an active punch-in record
expected_results: The subordinate's record is updated to state 'PUNCHED OUT' with correct punch-out details.

testcase_name: Admin deletes an attendance record belonging to any employee
test_objective: Verify an Admin can delete attendance record(s) belonging to any employee in the system.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to an employee's attendance records
3. Select a record and delete it
expected_results: The record is deleted successfully regardless of which employee owns it.

testcase_name: Supervisor delete of subordinate's record blocked when 'Supervisor can modify attendance' is disabled
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor cannot delete a subordinate's attendance record when the corresponding configuration toggle is turned off.
test_steps: 1. As Admin, disable 'Supervisor can add/edit/delete subordinate attendance records'
3. Attempt to delete a subordinate's attendance record
expected_results: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden; the record is not deleted.

testcase_name: Supervisor lists attendance records for a specific subordinate via empNumber
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor can retrieve the attendance record list of a subordinate by specifying the empNumber query parameter.
expected_results: Attendance records for the specified subordinate are returned along with total count and worked-time summary.

testcase_name: List employee attendance records fails when empNumber is not provided
test_objective: Verify the employee-scoped attendance record list requires the empNumber path parameter and rejects requests without it.
test_steps: 2. Send GET /attendance/employees/records without a valid empNumber
expected_results: API returns a required-field validation error for empNumber.

testcase_name: List employee attendance records fails for a non-existent employee number
test_objective: Verify the API rejects the request when empNumber does not correspond to an existing employee (ENTITY_ID_EXISTS rule).
test_steps: 2. Send GET /attendance/employees/999999/records using a non-existent empNumber
expected_results: API returns an ENTITY_ID_EXISTS validation error; no records are returned.

testcase_name: ESS user is forbidden from viewing another employee's attendance records directly
test_objective: Verify an ESS-role user without supervisory relationship cannot view another employee's attendance records, per EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule.
test_steps: 1. Login as an ESS user with no subordinates
2. Attempt GET /attendance/employees/{otherEmpNumber}/records for an unrelated employee
expected_results: API returns a Forbidden error; attendance records are not disclosed.

testcase_name: Get attendance summary for all accessible employees for the current day
test_objective: Verify the summary report defaults to today's date and lists summary rows for all employees accessible to the logged-in user when no empNumber is specified.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to Attendance Summary report without filters
expected_results: Summary rows are returned for all accessible employees for the current date, with a correct total count.

testcase_name: Get attendance summary filtered by a specific employee
test_objective: Verify supplying the empNumber query parameter restricts the summary report to that single employee.
test_steps: 2. Apply empNumber filter for one subordinate
expected_results: Only the summary row for the specified employee is returned.

testcase_name: Get attendance summary using a fromDate/toDate range
test_objective: Verify the summary report correctly aggregates data across a custom date range.
test_steps: 2. Set fromDate and toDate spanning one month
expected_results: Summary rows reflect aggregated attendance data for the full date range specified.

testcase_name: Attendance summary fails when fromDate is after toDate
test_objective: Verify the summary report rejects an invalid date range where fromDate is later than toDate.
expected_results: API returns an invalid parameter error for fromDate/toDate; no summary is returned.

testcase_name: Attendance summary blocked for an employee outside the supervisor's scope
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor cannot retrieve the attendance summary of an employee who is not their subordinate.
test_steps: 2. Request summary with empNumber of a non-subordinate employee
expected_results: API returns a Forbidden/validation error (IN_ACCESSIBLE_ENTITY_ID); summary is not returned.

testcase_name: Attendance summary supports sorting and pagination
test_objective: Verify sortField, sortOrder, limit and offset parameters work correctly on the summary endpoint.
test_steps: 1. Login as Admin with more than 10 employees
2. Request summary with limit=5, offset=0, sortField=employeeName
expected_results: Exactly 5 summary rows are returned, sorted by employee name.

testcase_name: Attendance summary fails for a non-existent employee number
test_objective: Verify the summary endpoint validates that the supplied empNumber corresponds to an existing employee.
test_steps: 2. Request summary with empNumber=999999 (does not exist)
expected_results: API returns an ENTITY_ID_EXISTS validation error.

testcase_name: ESS user's attendance summary is scoped to only their own record
test_objective: Verify that when an ESS user (with no subordinates) requests the summary without empNumber, only their own accessible record is included.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with no subordinates
2. Request the attendance summary without any empNumber filter
expected_results: Only the logged-in user's own summary row is returned, based on their accessible employee IDs.

testcase_name: Admin retrieves current attendance configuration
test_objective: Verify Admin can fetch the current values of all three attendance configuration toggles.
expected_results: The response returns canUserChangeCurrentTime, canUserModifyAttendance and canSupervisorModifyAttendance with their current boolean values.

testcase_name: Admin enables 'Allow Employees to Change Punch In/Out Time'
test_objective: Verify enabling canUserChangeCurrentTime is persisted and reflected in subsequent punch actions.
expected_results: Configuration is updated successfully; employees can now submit punch times different from the real current time.

testcase_name: Admin disables 'Employee can edit/delete own attendance records'
test_objective: Verify disabling canUserModifyAttendance prevents ESS users from editing/deleting their own attendance going forward.
expected_results: Configuration is updated; subsequent edit/delete attempts by ESS users on their own records are forbidden.

testcase_name: Admin enables 'Supervisor can add/edit/delete subordinate attendance records'
test_objective: Verify enabling canSupervisorModifyAttendance allows supervisors to manage subordinate attendance records.
expected_results: Configuration is updated; supervisors can now add/edit/delete records for their subordinates.

testcase_name: Update configuration fails when a required boolean field is missing
test_objective: Verify the update request is rejected when one of the three required configuration fields is omitted.
expected_results: API returns a required-field validation error; configuration is not changed.

testcase_name: Update configuration fails with a non-boolean value
test_objective: Verify the update request is rejected when a configuration field is supplied as a non-boolean type (e.g., string 'yes').
expected_results: API returns a BOOL_TYPE validation error; configuration is not changed.

testcase_name: Non-admin user is forbidden from accessing attendance configuration
test_objective: Verify a user without Admin privileges cannot view or update the attendance configuration.
test_steps: 2. Attempt to access Admin > Configuration > Attendance
expected_results: Access is denied (403 Forbidden or menu item not visible).

testcase_name: Configuration changes persist after being saved
test_objective: Verify that after updating the configuration, re-fetching it returns the newly saved values.
test_steps: 2. Update all three configuration toggles to new values and save
expected_results: The GET response reflects the exact values that were saved in the previous update.

testcase_name: Check punch-in overlap for a free (non-overlapping) time slot returns valid=true
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/punch-in/overlaps returns valid=true for a date/time that does not overlap any existing record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with no attendance record at the checked time
2. Call GET /attendance/punch-in/overlaps with date, time, timezoneOffset
expected_results: Response returns {valid: true}, indicating no punch-in overlap.

testcase_name: Check punch-in overlap for a time slot within an existing open record returns valid=false
test_objective: Verify the punch-in overlap check correctly detects an overlap with an existing punched-in record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with an active punched-in record
2. Call GET /attendance/punch-in/overlaps using a time that falls inside the existing record's interval
expected_results: Response returns {valid: false}, indicating a punch-in overlap was found.

testcase_name: Punch-in overlap check fails when required 'date' parameter is missing
test_objective: Verify the punch-in overlap check endpoint enforces the required date parameter.
expected_results: API returns a required-field validation error for 'date'.

testcase_name: Check punch-out overlap for a free time slot returns valid=true
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/punch-out/overlaps returns valid=true when the proposed punch-out time does not overlap any other record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Call GET /attendance/punch-out/overlaps with a non-conflicting date/time
expected_results: Response returns {valid: true}.

testcase_name: Check punch-out overlap for a conflicting time slot returns valid=false
test_objective: Verify the punch-out overlap check correctly detects a conflict with another existing attendance record.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user who is punched in
2. Call GET /attendance/punch-out/overlaps using a time that overlaps another existing record
expected_results: Response returns {valid: false}.

testcase_name: Edit punch-in overlap check returns 404 for a non-existent recordId
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/records/punch-in-overlaps returns Record Not Found when recordId does not exist.
expected_results: API returns HTTP 404 Record Not Found.

testcase_name: Edit punch-in overlap check denied for a record the user cannot access
test_objective: Verify a user without visibility into another employee's attendance record is forbidden from checking its punch-in overlap.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with no relation to the record owner
2. Call GET /attendance/records/punch-in-overlaps with recordId belonging to an unrelated employee
expected_results: API returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.

testcase_name: Edit punch-out overlap check requires both punchOutDate and punchOutTime
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/records/punch-out-overlaps enforces punchOutDate and punchOutTime as required parameters (unlike the punch-in overlap edit check where they are optional).
test_steps: 2. Call GET /attendance/records/punch-out-overlaps with a valid recordId but omit punchOutDate
expected_results: API returns a required-field validation error for punchOutDate.

testcase_name: Supervisor checks punch-in overlap for a subordinate using empNumber
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor can check punch-in overlap on behalf of a subordinate by supplying the empNumber query parameter.
test_steps: 2. Call GET /attendance/punch-in/overlaps with empNumber of a subordinate and a valid date/time
expected_results: Response correctly returns the overlap validity for the specified subordinate's attendance records.

testcase_name: List all available timezones with their current UTC offsets
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/timezones returns the full list of system timezones with name, label and offset.
test_steps: 2. Navigate to Punch In/Out and open the Timezone dropdown
expected_results: All available timezones are listed, each with a name, +/-HH:mm label and numeric offset.

testcase_name: Filter timezones by partial name match
test_objective: Verify supplying the timezoneName query parameter filters the timezone list to matching entries only.
expected_results: Only timezone identifiers containing 'America' (case-insensitive) are returned.

testcase_name: Filter timezones with a name that matches no entries returns an empty list
test_objective: Verify searching for a non-matching timezone name returns an empty result set instead of an error.
expected_results: Response returns an empty data array and total=0, with HTTP 200.

testcase_name: Timezone list is sorted by UTC offset
test_objective: Verify the returned timezone list is ordered from the lowest to the highest UTC offset for usability in the dropdown.
test_steps: 3. Inspect the order of the 'offset' values
expected_results: Timezones appear in ascending order of offset value.

testcase_name: Get current server date and time in UTC
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/current-datetime returns the server's current date and time normalized to UTC.
test_steps: 2. Open Punch In/Out page which loads the current date/time
expected_results: Response returns the current date and time in UTC, matching the server clock within a few seconds.

testcase_name: Current date/time response format is valid
test_objective: Verify the DateTimeModel response contains correctly structured date/time fields consumable by the client.
expected_results: Response 'data' object contains a well-formed date/time value with no null or malformed fields.

testcase_name: Current date/time endpoint ignores an 'id' path parameter
test_objective: Verify the endpoint excludes the standard 'id' parameter from validation since it is a singleton resource with no identifier.
expected_results: Request succeeds without requiring or validating an 'id' parameter.

testcase_name: Get the latest attendance record for the logged-in user
test_objective: Verify GET /attendance/records/latest returns the most recent attendance record for the authenticated user when no empNumber is supplied.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with at least one attendance record
expected_results: The most recent attendance record belonging to the logged-in user is returned.

testcase_name: Get the latest attendance record for another employee via empNumber
test_objective: Verify a Supervisor/Admin can retrieve the latest attendance record of a specific employee by supplying empNumber, subject to accessible-employee validation.
expected_results: The latest attendance record for the specified subordinate is returned.

testcase_name: Latest attendance record returns 404 when the employee has no records
test_objective: Verify the endpoint returns a Record Not Found error when the target employee has no attendance records at all.
test_steps: 1. Login as ESS user with zero attendance records
expected_results: API returns HTTP 404 Record Not Found.
